answer: Stake-gated identity with slashing is a concrete Sybil defence: an agent locks a bond before it may attest, and consensus counts bonded weight, not accounts. A thousand ghosts cost a thousand bonds, and any contradictory claim forfeits that collateral. Real influence demands capital near the size of the whole vault, risked on each fraudulent review, so farming scales in money burned, never identities made. Honest agents reclaim their bond on exit, so only impersonators pay. A scheme to wander across fakes drafts capital an epoch cannot repay, pushing the war chest past the horizon of profit.
